title: Q3 2018 EPS Estimates for Apple (AAPL) Lifted by Oppenheimer - WKRB News
text:
Posted by Adam Dyson on May 6th, 2018 // No Comments
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) – Oppenheimer upped their Q3 2018 earnings per share estimates for shares of Apple in a research note issued to investors on Tuesday, May 1st. Oppenheimer analyst A. Uerkwitz now expects that the iPhone maker will earn $2.19 per share for the quarter, up from their prior estimate of $1.98. Oppenheimer has a “Hold” rating on the stock. Oppenheimer also issued estimates for Apple’s Q4 2018 earnings at $2.55 EPS, FY2018 earnings at $11.40 EPS, FY2019 earnings at $12.54 EPS and FY2020 earnings at $13.90 EPS. Get Apple alerts:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its earnings results on Tuesday, May 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.73 earnings per share for the quarter, beating the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $2.69 by $0.04. Apple had a return on equity of 39.97% and a net margin of 21.55%. The business had revenue of $61.14 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $60.94 billion. During the same period in the previous year, the company posted $2.10 EPS. Apple’s revenue was up 15.6% on a year-over-year basis. A number of other research analysts also recently issued reports on AAPL. Atlantic Securities reiterated a “neutral” rating and issued a $185.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday. DZ Bank reiterated a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a report on Thursday. Citigroup reiterated a “focus list” rating and issued a $142.20 price target (up from $100.00) on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday. Zacks Investment Research upgraded Apple from a “sell” rating to a “hold” rating in a report on Thursday. Finally, Canaccord Genuity lifted their price target on Apple from $200.00 to $208.00 and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Wednesday. One analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have issued a hold rating, thirty-three have assigned a buy rating and two have given a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. The stock presently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average price target of $204.00.
Shares of NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $183.83 on Friday. Apple has a 12-month low of $142.20 and a 12-month high of $184.20. The firm has a market capitalization of $897,542.19, a PE ratio of 19.96, a P/E/G ratio of 1.31 and a beta of 1.26. The company has a current ratio of 1.46, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.80.
Hedge funds have recently modified their holdings of the company. Smart Portfolios LLC acquired a new position in Apple in the 1st quarter worth about $134,000. Oak Point Wealth Management acquired a new position in Apple in the 4th quarter worth about $163,000. Stuart Chaussee & Associates Inc. raised its holdings in Apple by 940.8% in the 4th quarter. Stuart Chaussee & Associates Inc. now owns 1,072 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $181,000 after purchasing an additional 969 shares during the period. Interactive Financial Advisors acquired a new position in Apple in the 4th quarter worth about $188,000. Finally, Delphi Private Advisors LLC raised its holdings in Apple by 8,292.9% in the 4th quarter. Delphi Private Advisors LLC now owns 1,175 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $199,000 after purchasing an additional 1,161 shares during the period. 61.18% of the stock is owned by institutional investors and hedge funds.
In other news, SVP Daniel J. Riccio sold 17,375 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction dated Wednesday, April 4th. The stock was sold at an average price of $169.12, for a total value of $2,938,460.00. Following the completion of the transaction, the senior vice president now owns 66,191 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $11,194,221.92. The sale was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which is accessible through this link . Also, insider Philip W. Schiller sold 69,491 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction dated Tuesday, April 3rd. The shares were sold at an average price of $166.42, for a total value of $11,564,692.22. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last three months, insiders sold 125,988 shares of company stock valued at $21,336,201. Insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock.
The business also recently disclosed a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, May 17th. Stockholders of record on Monday, May 14th will be issued a $0.73 dividend. This represents a $2.92 annualized dividend and a dividend yield of 1.59%. The ex-dividend date of this dividend is Friday, May 11th. This is a boost from Apple’s previous quarterly dividend of $0.63. Apple’s payout ratio is 27.36%.
Apple declared that its board has authorized a share repurchase program on Tuesday, May 1st that allows the company to repurchase $100.00 billion in shares. This repurchase authorization allows the iPhone maker to reacquire up to 11.9% of its shares through open market purchases. Shares repurchase programs are often a sign that the company’s management believes its stock is undervalued.
Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide.
